Leading a Data Science, ML and Engineering (DSE) team of 6 data scientists and 3 Java/Python engineers across 5 time zones in AdTech: OpenRTB Exchange, RTB, SSP, DSP and DMP. Responsible for planning, Agile/Scrum, retrospectives, performance tracking, hiring, onboarding, mentoring and cross-team coordination. Delivered 20 quarterly plans, 3 internal services, 5 ML models and migrated all ML projects to a new data center in 3 months.

Built high-load, low-latency distributed systems. Designed a DMP on asynchronous Java, gRPC, Cassandra and Redis serving 30B entities at p99 5ms. Built a supply prediction system (24M docs/day, Lucene, Spring Framework, CatBoost), an RTB scoring throttle that cut servers by 50%, an async ads.txt/app-ads.txt crawler on Netty (500K domains/day), a 100K QPS domain attribution service (gRPC, REST), a JSQ client-side balancer with circuit breakers (p95 6ms to 1ms), and a 300K QPS DoubleVerify cluster. Created Docker image hierarchies, TestContainers-style Redis/Cassandra integration tests, ETL pipelines and reporting with alerting (Luigi, Hive, Impala, Presto, Trino, Jupyter) and served in 3rd-line on-call support on Linux.

Delivered production ML models: look-alike audiences, video completion rate, gender prediction (Bayes), win-rate, NPI and ICD10 attribution quality for HCP and DTC targeting on clean-room data, NPI and domain embeddings (Contrastive Learning, HDBSCAN), app store embeddings and a 15-audience builder. Built NLP/LLM healthcare solutions: semantic encoder, medical contextualizer and entity extractor (Hugging Face, Transformers, GLiNER, UMLS, Lightning, multi-GPU) and an AI agent "Council" for automated model improvement (ACP, Copilot CLI).

Stack: Python, Java, PyTorch, CatBoost, Scikit-learn, Optuna, TensorBoard, FastAPI, Flask, Gunicorn, CherryPy, Nginx, Streamlit, Plotly, SQL, Docker, Kubernetes (K8S), Google Cloud, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, versioned ML model storage, MLOps.
